reasoning_summary: Sisowath Kossamak was born as the daughter of King Sisowath Monivong, making him her father-in-law through her marriage to King Norodom Suramarit. This relationship is well-supported by the evidence provided.

atomic_answer_trace.question: Who is Kossamak?
